# Marylene Delbourg-Delphis

> Serial technology CEO, executive consultant, board member and author, based in Silicon Valley since 1987. One of the first European women to found (with Guy Kawasaki) a technology company in the Valley. She founded ACI (now 4th Dimension) in Paris, then led Exemplary Software, Brixlogic and TalentCircles as CEO. Author of Beyond Eureka! (Georgetown University Press, 2024) and Everybody Wants to Love Their Job (2018). Knight of the Legion of Honour (2018). Beyond Eureka! received a Silver Medal at the 2026 Axiom Book Awards. The site is bilingual: English and French, with a language toggle on every page.

Official site of Marylene Delbourg-Delphis (also written Marylène Delbourg-Delphis in French). She is a graduate of the École normale supérieure with a doctorate in philosophy, studied under Michel Serres, and has been a CEO of four companies and an advisor or board member of more than thirty. Her topics are innovation, company culture and belonging, emotional intelligence as data, diversity by design, and women in technology.

## Pages
- [Home](https://www.delbourg-delphis.org/): who she is, praise for her books, speaking topics, recent LinkedIn posts.
- [About](https://www.delbourg-delphis.org/about): full biography, career milestones (ACI 1985, ACIUS 1987, Legion of Honour 2018) and areas of expertise.
- [Books](https://www.delbourg-delphis.org/book): New book Working with Another Intelligence, with Gregory Renard (foreword by Guy Kawasaki; ebook and audiobook in English and French, out 16 December 2026; https://working-with-another-intelligence.com/). Also Beyond Eureka! The Rocky Roads to Innovating (Georgetown University Press, June 2024, foreword by Guy Kawasaki; 2026 Axiom Book Awards Silver Medal; endorsed by Renée Mauborgne, Brian Solis, Chris Yeh, Eugenie Rives, Alexandre Bayen and Sramana Mitra) and Everybody Wants to Love Their Job: Rebuilding Trust and Culture (2018; French edition: Tout le monde veut aimer son travail).
- [Speaking](https://www.delbourg-delphis.org/speaking): keynote topics (Role Models and Mentors, Diversity by Design, Above the Glass Ceiling, Emotional Intelligence is about Data, Culture is about Belongingness), customizable for teams or large events.
- [Writings](https://www.delbourg-delphis.org/more): books in French on the history of fashion and fragrances, and French translations and prefaces of Guy Kawasaki, Seth Godin, Robert Scoble and others (Éditions Diateino).
- [Blog](https://www.delbourg-delphis.org/blog): book reviews and posts about new books, trends and innovators, published on LinkedIn.
- [Contact](https://www.delbourg-delphis.org/contact): contact form for speaking, advisory and board, press and book inquiries.
